claims 1-44 are rejected under 35 u.s.c. 112(b) or 35 u.s.c. 112 (pre-aia ), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor, or for pre-aia the applicant regards as the invention.
a). claim 1 recites “said membranes” with no antecedent basis.
b). claim 2 recites “a plurality of sensors” and it is unclear whether “a plurality of sensors” includes the previously recited “at least one sensor.”
c). claim 2 recites “at least one of said pv” with no antecedent basis.
d). claim 2 recites “at least two membranes,” “one of said desalination membranes,” “at least one of said two or more desalination membranes,” and “at least one of said two or more desalination membrane,” with no antecedent basis.
e). claim 3 recites “said sensor” with no antecedent basis.
f). claim 4 recites “said sensor” with no antecedent basis.
g). claim 5 recites “said sensor” with no antecedent basis.
